scientific_integrity: Proof and two independent exhaustive checkers are supplied. The general statement depends on the proof, not extrapolation from finite tests. Previously published facts about the existence of frozen adjacent-swap states and unrestricted-transposition connectivity are expressly credited.
scientific_limitations: All-order claim covers derangements under swaps of positions at ordinary linear distance at most one or two; not cyclic distance, arbitrary swaps, individual component diameters, or mixing time. An exact earlier public online release day for the 2004 foundational paper was not established. Historical originality is qualified and independent scholarly verification has not occurred.
source_date_evidence: The Baril–Vajnovszki article belongs to Discrete Applied Mathematics volume 140, issues 1–3, publicly dated 15 May 2004. No earlier exact public posting date was verified; manuscript received/revised/accepted dates were not substituted for public release dates.
title: Hypercube component geometry and a sharp two-position threshold for derangement swaps
